title: GitCreateUserRequest
description: The request used to create a new user

extern_uid.description: External UID used when linking to OIDC or federated logins

provider.description: The provider that created this user, used to link your system to gitlab user.

username.description: The username of the user in the actual gitlab instance.

name.description: The name of the user for displaying such as given name and family name.

email.description: The email address of the user.

avatar.description: The URL of the avatar for the user profile.

organization.description: The organization name that this user belongs to.

force_random_password.description: Will force the password of the user to a random password
